sources.title: Nobody Told Me reviews | Exa place listing
sources.text: So, I really do like this cute spot on the UWS, and would customarily give it 5 stars. The food is always good, and prices reasonable . Their cocktails are interesting and delicious. The service depends on whose on that day, but it's usually ok. And I love the design of the place. Today, however, a customer bought a dog and a cat inside the restaurant. Who the hell brings a cat INSIDE of a restaurant?? Aren't there sanitary rules about this? The creature was adorable, so much so, that the waitress cuddled it before going back to the bar, surely covering herself with cat dander.
